question: Can one agent, driving all five staged level-20 characters of the party through what their clients see, walk from Moonbrook into the Deadmines and defeat Edwin VanCleef?
note: The scored one-agent Deadmines episode (operator, 2026-11-14). Pinned by the id: the start, the characters, the directive, the end and the budget. Everything is deadmines@5's: the same five characters in the same member order and roles, staged on moonbrook-mine at level 20, the cell carrying the leader's start, the end on a kill of Edwin VanCleef (creature entry 639), the one agent's directive (the top-level objective), and the budget (four hours for now, idle 20 minutes, the no-XP watchdog off, the 8000-call guard). The members' objectives are deadmines@4's, carried for the schema and never shown on this id. Resume and the attempt cap are the scored lane's, not this file's.

cells.note: The party; its start is the leader's, the Human Warrior tank.

objective: You play every member of a party of five: Tankpartyb (warrior, the party leader), Healpartyc (priest), Magepartyd (mage), Roguepartye (rogue) and Palapartyf (paladin). Tankpartyb is the party's tank, Healpartyc its healer, and Magepartyd, Roguepartye and Palapartyf its damage. The party stands in the mine under Moonbrook, Westfall, a few yards from the portal into the Deadmines at (-11208, 1685, 26). The objective for this run is for the party to clear the Deadmines and defeat Edwin VanCleef.
